summary: Banco Santander filed a 6-K announcing a tender offer to purchase for cash up to $850M of its outstanding 4.750% Non-Step-Up Non-Cumulative Contingent Convertible Perpetual Preferred Tier 1 Securities (CUSIP 05971K AH2), representing 85% of the $1B principal outstanding. The purchase price is 100.1% of nominal amount ($1,001 per $1,000), with securities tendered in $200,000 multiples. No premium percentage is specified. The offer is to manage Tier 1 capital position and optimize liquidity and debt maturity. No board recommendation or advisors are named. Purchased securities will be cancelled. The maximum amount may be increased or decreased at Santander's discretion. What to watch: acceptance and pro-ration conditions; risk-arb focuses on tender participation and any changes to offer terms.
